method.score_bound: min(1, final occupied length / (ceil(peak live length / 20) * 20)) * official test weight
method.headroom: volume upper-bound weighted score minus exact baseline weighted score
method.trace_replay: For each positive command, consume the judge trace start coordinate and extend free space by the reported 20m-section count; for each negative PID, validate the returned start and merge that interval. Replay checks trench, final occupancy, and peak live volume against the saved official harness summary.
method.growth_fragmentation: At each positive command that digs, record free volume and largest single free gap immediately before growth. Existing free volume sufficient but no single gap large enough is classified as fragmentation-sensitive growth; a physically fitting existing gap at a growth event is separately reported as a possible algorithmic lane/eligibility constraint.
method.permanent_blockers: End-surviving pipes are only called end survivors; separator count is the subset with a final free gap directly on both sides. No claim is made that these pipes are permanent beyond the input.
method.flow_type: Descriptive placement-size entropy/dominance/run metrics and deletion PID-rank shares; labels are heuristic and are not claims about the hidden generator.
